policies.metaDescription: PlantHaat terms, privacy, refund and delivery policies.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: Please read these terms before using PlantHaat.

sections.title: Accounts
sections.body: Create an account with accurate information and keep your password private. You are responsible for all activity on your account.

sections.title: Orders and pricing
sections.body: Prices and stock are shown from the server and verified when an order is confirmed. We may cancel an order before it is confirmed.

sections.title: Seller responsibilities
sections.body: Sellers are responsible for accurate information, healthy plants and on-time delivery. No shop is activated without verification.

sections.title: Prohibited activity
sections.body: Fraud, false information or selling restricted plants may result in account suspension.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: We respect your personal information and only collect what we need to provide the service.

sections.title: Information we collect
sections.body: Name, phone, email and address — to process orders and deliver them.

sections.title: How we use it
sections.body: To fulfil orders, provide support, prevent fraud and improve the service. We do not sell your data.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.body: We use essential cookies to remember your language and keep you signed in.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You can request to view, correct or delete your information.

refundCancellation.title: Refund & cancellation policy
refundCancellation.intro: We handle refunds and cancellations fairly and transparently.

sections.title: Cancelling an order
sections.body: Customers can cancel directly while an order is PENDING. Once it is CONFIRMED or PACKED, you can request a cancellation that the seller approves.

sections.title: Damaged or wrong plants
sections.body: File a complaint with photos within the return window. After verification we offer a refund or replacement.

sections.title: Refunds
sections.body: Approved refunds are returned through the original or an agreed payment method, usually within 3–7 working days.

sections.title: What is not covered
sections.body: Plants damaged through customer neglect, or complaints filed long after delivery, are not eligible.

delivery.title: Delivery policy
delivery.intro: Plants are delivered carefully all across Bangladesh.

sections.title: Delivery time
sections.body: Usually 2–5 working days, depending on the district and the seller's delivery zone.

sections.title: Delivery charges
sections.body: Charges are set by the seller's delivery zones and shown clearly at checkout.

sections.title: Packaging
sections.body: Special packaging is used so plants arrive safe and healthy.

sections.title: If delivery fails
sections.body: If you do not receive your plant in the estimated time, tell us with your order number and we will coordinate with the seller.
